title: Kitten and Cow Share Peaceful Moment Together
description:
A gentle Highland calf approached a kitten in the pasture and softly nudged her onto her back, inviting play. The kitten responded by patting his face affectionately. They interacted like old friends, showing no fear or hesitation. The moment, unstaged and spontaneous, captured a peaceful bond between unlikely companions.
